newsitem.title: USA: Some U.S. meat packers to close for Veterans Day.
newsitem.headline: Some U.S. meat packers to close for Veterans Day.

text.p: National Beef Packing Co, a unit of Farmland Industries Inc said one of its two feed cattle slaughter and beef plants will be closed Monday in observance of the U.S. Veterans Day holiday, a company official said.
The plant is located in Liberal, Kan. National's other plant in Dodge City, Kan. will remain open.
Farmland's three hog and pork plants in Iowa, Nebraska and Illinois will be open, said an official with the company's pork division.
IBP Inc Thursday said three of its 12 fed cattle slaughter and beef plants will be closed Monday. The three plants are in Amarillo, Texas; Emporia, Kan.; and West Point, Neb.
All of IBP's hog and pork plants will operate Monday, the spokesman said.

Early Thursday, Hormel Foods Corp said its Austin, Minn., pork processing plant and Fremont, Neb, hog slaughter plant will be closed Monday for the holiday. Also closed Monday will be Quality Pork Processing Inc's hog slaughtering plant in Austin, which provides fresh pork for Hormel's Austin plant, a Quality Pork company official said.
Cargill Inc's beef subsidiary, Excel Corp, said its six beef plants and three pork plants will be open Monday.
Officials with other U.S. beef and pork companies were unavailable to comment regarding Monday operations.
